The city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] had a '''power generator''' that ran to several smaller generators. The smaller generators were linked to the main unit and would not function if the main unit was disabled.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] utilized the power generator to provide energy for his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces in the city.<ref name="Front Runners" />

Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="A War on Two Fronts Date" /> the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] saw an opportunity to help defeat the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|occupation]] in this generator. The rebels used an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] they had stolen from [[Patrol 118/Legends|Patrol 118]] to blow up the generator, causing Iziz's power to shut down.<ref name="Front Runners" />
